title: School Service Commission posts interview shortlists for 8,477 clerk and Group D posts
dek: The first fresh hiring of school non-teaching staff since the Supreme Court scrapped the 2016 panel moves to the interview stage; dates are yet to be announced.
author: Declaration Desk
body:
The West Bengal School Service Commission (WBSSC) has put up the results of the written test for 8,477 clerk and Group D posts in state-aided schools, opening search pages on its website where candidates can check, by roll number and name, whether they have been called for the next stage.

The pages are titled "Result For Preliminary Interview" for the first State Level Selection Test for non-teaching staff, 2025, with separate pages for Group C (clerks) and Group D. Job portals reported that the lists went up on Thursday along with region-wise cut-off marks. The commission has not yet announced dates for document verification and interviews.

The recruitment covers 2,989 Group C and 5,488 Group D posts, according to figures reported by Outlook when the posts were advertised in November 2025.

The test is the first fresh recruitment of school non-teaching staff since the Supreme Court in April 2025 cancelled the entire 2016 panel, voiding about 25,753 teaching and non-teaching appointments because of large-scale irregularities. The commission later published a list of 3,512 non-teaching staff from that panel, 1,163 in Group C and 2,349 in Group D, whom it identified as "tainted"; they are barred from the new process.

The figures here are preliminary. A shortlist for interview is not an offer of appointment, and final selection depends on document verification and interview.
